kwargs.content: {"summary":"After deploy v7.8.0 of orders at 11:02, p99 latency rose about 5x (from roughly 290 ms to 1450 ms) and the error rate rose from 0.4% to about 8% starting around 11:04-11:05. The new code issued extra per-line-item queries and threw NullPointerExceptions for orders with no discount record, which exhausted the 48-connection Postgres pool. Rolling back to v7.7.3 restored latency to baseline but the pool stayed near 97% and errors stayed at 5%. Scaling the pool to 96 connections brought pool utilisation to 55%, error rate to 0.5% and p99 to about 300 ms, so the symptoms cleared.","timeline":["2026-03-20T11:02:00Z - Deploy v7.8.0 (deploy-001) released; orders-api-4d2 started v7.8.0 at 11:02:50","2026-03-20T11:04:20Z - First NullPointerException in apply_discount_rules","2026-03-20T11:05:00Z - Pool utilisation 98%, error rate 7%, p99 latency 1400 ms","2026-03-20T11:06:41Z - Logs show connection pool exhausted (48/48) with requests waiting 3000 ms","2026-03-20T11:30:00Z - Metrics still degraded: pool 98%, error rate 8%, p99 1450 ms","Action 1 - Rolled back deploy-001 to v7.7.3","2026-03-20T11:40:00Z - After rollback p99 back to baseline (310 ms) but pool at 97% and error rate at 5%","Action 2 - Scaled the Postgres pool to 96 connections","2026-03-20T11:50:00Z - Pool utilisation 55%, error rate 0.5%, p99 300 ms; symptoms cleared"],"root_cause":"Deploy v7.8.0 rewrote apply_discount_rules to query discounts per line item and did not handle orders with no discount record. This caused NullPointerExceptions and many extra queries, which exhausted the 48-connection Postgres pool.
